header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنْ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْمُؤْمِنُ مِرْآةُ الْمُؤْمِنِ، وَالْمُؤْمِنُ اَخُو الْمُؤْمِنِ، يَكُفُّ عَلَيْهِ ضَيْعَتَهُ وَيَحُوْطُهُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في النصيحة والحياطة رقم:٤٩١٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “One Mu'min is a mirror for another Mu'min, and one Mu'min is a brother to another Mu'min. He prevents harm from reaching him through himself, and he protects him from all sides.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اُنْصُرْ اَخَاكَ ظاَلِمًا اَوْ مَظْلُوْمًا، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! اَنْصُرُهُ اِذَا كَانَ مَظْلُوْمًا، اَفَرَاَيْتَ اِذَا كَانَ ظَالِمًا كَيْفَ اَنْصُرُهُ؟ قَالَ: تَحْجُزُهُ اَوْ تَمْنَعُهُ مِنَ الظُّلْمِ، فَاِنَّ ذلِكَ نَصْرُهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب يمين الرجل لصاحبه انه اخوه ...... رقم:٦٩٥٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) has narrated that when Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Help your Muslim brother in every situation, whether he is the one doing injustice or the one wronged!” a man asked, “Ya Rasulallah, I will help the one who is wronged, but how do I help the one who does injustice?” Rasulullah ﷺ replied, “Stop him from doing injustice. For stopping the wrongdoer from doing injustice is the help you give him.”
